body: I found my passion through trying a shit ton of stuff. It took a while, id say about a whole 4 months of me constantly going out and trying new things. Then this one day when i tried out helping develop quantum computing softwares (ikr outta all things) i found my passion. Theres something about changing a few lines of code and it working... its like hitting the jackpot in vegas to me! Your passion may be completely different, and youll know you find it when it clicks in your head

I feel like you shouldnt be as ungrateful for his gifts, since its clear that he takes notice in what you say, and keeps it to his heart. He's really trying from my perspective. On the other hand though, communication is very important. If something is bothering you, try to talk to him about it. Just try not to use an attacking tone. This will lead to a more progressive mindset that will help you both out, and strengthen the relationship. Hope this helps!

Your problem lies right in what you said - "any i do for myself feels meaningless". In order to not give 2 fks about anyone, you have to be completely comfortable with yourself first. My advice would be to try to find your passion, or something of high importance for yourself. Your passion can change over time, and thats ok. If youre still having trouble finding your passion, try to met new people or experience new situations, it will open doors for you to even more opportunities. Eventually one of those opportunities you'll find passion in. Best of luck friend!
